step1_analysis.description: A simple differential capacitor block consisting of two 400fF capacitors connected in parallel (anti-parallel), providing a total equivalent capacitance of 800fF. Given the context of a high-order interface for micromachined inertial sensors and an ADC, this is likely used as a sampling, integration, or feedback capacitor in a switched-capacitor circuit.

paper_reference.title: A Fourth-Order Interface for Micromachined Inertial Sensors

total_capacitance.description: The equivalent capacitance between the OUT+ and OUT- terminals.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The netlist explicitly defines two 400fF ideal capacitors in parallel.

f3db_test.description: The -3dB cutoff frequency when driven through a 1 MOhm test resistor, used to indirectly measure the capacitance.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the RC time constant of the test setup (1 MOhm and 800fF).

step3_testbench.description: Measures the total capacitance by forming an RC low-pass filter with a 1 MOhm resistor and finding the -3dB frequency.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Capacitor Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Test setup components
V1 IN 0 dc 0 ac 1
R1 IN OUT+ 1Meg
V2 OUT- 0 dc 0

* DUT
C1 OUT+ OUT- 400f
C2 OUT- OUT+ 400f

.control
ac dec 100 1k 10Meg
let gain_db = vdb(OUT+)
meas ac f3db when gain_db=-3.0103 fall=1
let measured_cap = 1 / (2 * 3.1415926535 * 1e6 * f3db)
print f3db
print measured_cap
quit
.endc
